integrity: The universal lower bound is analytic, using trace-distance contraction between an explicit symmetric input pair. The matching channel is explicit. The bundled checker verifies only algebraic transcription and the sharp constant.
scientific_limitations: One-round N=2 normalized-square target on the commuting diagonal-qubit family only. The result concerns deterministic CPTP state output and does not constrain postselected/heralded purification, signed observable estimators, higher powers, noncommuting families, or higher local dimension.
title: Exact deterministic-state barrier for two-copy qubit power purification
